en.commentary: Bitwarden takes the top spot because it is the only vault here where the free tier is a complete product. Unlimited devices, unlimited entries, and full passkey storage cost nothing, and Premium sits at $19.80 a year after the January 2026 increase that doubled it from $9.99. Even doubled, that is the cheapest annually audited vault I can point someone at. The April 22 npm incident, where a malicious @bitwarden/cli@2026.4.0 package sat live for about 90 minutes, was contained to developer tooling and left end-user vaults untouched, and Bitwarden published a full timeline within days. That disclosure speed is exactly what I score on. 1Password lands second on the strength of its Secret Key architecture, a 128-bit value stored on your device and combined with the master password before any key derivation happens. It means a server-side copy of your encrypted vault is useless on its own, which is why 1Password remains the one major vault whose customer data has stayed sealed through every incident in the category. The March 27 price move to $47.88 a year for Individual and $71.88 for Families is what keeps it off the top step. Proton Pass is the value pick of 2026. The Plus tier now runs $23.88 a year and bundles unlimited SimpleLogin aliases, so you get a vault and an email-alias service for less than most vaults alone. One theme runs through this year and it changes how I score. The February 16 paper from ETH Zurich and Università della Svizzera italiana constructed 27 working attacks against cloud vaults by simulating a hostile server, and it moved 'which one is actually safe' from marketing copy to peer-reviewed evidence. Combine that with 5 billion passkeys now in circulation and iOS 26 finally shipping an OS-level export API, and the right question in 2026 is which vault lets you leave with your credentials intact. Bitwarden, Proton Pass and Apple Passwords all answer that cleanly.

highlights.title: Bitwarden at $19.80 a year is still the best value in security software
highlights.body: The January 2026 increase from $9.99 to $19.80 annoyed a lot of long-time users, largely because Bitwarden folded the news into a feature blog post rather than announcing it plainly. Look at what the number buys. Every competitor at that price point caps devices, caps entries, or gates passkey storage behind a paid tier. Bitwarden's free plan has none of those limits, and Premium adds TOTP generation, emergency access, 1GB of encrypted attachments and vault health reports. Individual users on 1Password now pay $47.88 a year, which is 2.4 times Bitwarden Premium for a vault with a comparable feature set.

highlights.title: 1Password's Secret Key is the single best architectural decision any vault has made
highlights.body: Every cloud password manager derives your encryption key from a master password. 1Password adds a 128-bit Secret Key generated on your device at signup and never transmitted to the server. Both values combine before key derivation, so an attacker who exfiltrates the entire encrypted vault database still needs something that never left your hardware. The practical proof is the record: through a decade of incidents across this category, 1Password customer vaults have stayed sealed. When I score breach history, architecture that makes a stolen database inert counts more than any certification badge.

highlights.title: The ETH Zurich paper changed what 'audited' is worth
highlights.body: On February 16, researchers from ETH Zurich and Università della Svizzera italiana published 27 working attack scenarios against Bitwarden, LastPass, Dashlane and 1Password, all built on the assumption of a malicious or compromised server. The severity ranged from integrity violations to full compromise of every vault in an organization, and the paper goes to USENIX Security in Baltimore this month. The lesson I take from it is that a SOC 2 report tells you a company followed a process, while this kind of adversarial cryptographic review tells you what happens when the server itself turns hostile. That second question is the one worth asking, and it is why I weight open-source, independently reviewable clients heavily.

highlights.title: Passkeys expand your password manager rather than replacing it
highlights.body: The FIDO Alliance counted 5 billion passkeys in circulation on World Passkey Day 2026, with 75% of surveyed consumers having enabled at least one. Here is what that actually means for your vault: most consumer passkeys live inside a password manager, so heavier passkey adoption puts more value in the vault, not less. iOS 26 and macOS 26 shipped the ASCredentialExportManager API implementing the FIDO Credential Exchange Protocol, and Bitwarden, Proton Pass and Apple Passwords all support moving passkeys out through it. Portability is now a first-class scoring factor for me, because a credential you cannot export is a credential your vendor controls.

highlights.title: Breach history belongs in the comparison table, and almost nobody puts it there
highlights.body: The UK ICO issued a £1,228,283 penalty on 20 November 2025 over the 2022 LastPass backup breach that exposed 1.6 million British users, citing inadequate technical and organisational measures. In June 2026, LastPass confirmed a second exposure of customer names, emails, phone numbers and support case contents through OAuth tokens stolen from vendor Klue, alongside roughly 200 other firms including HackerOne and Snyk. Core vaults were unaffected in that second event. I list these because a vault's security record is the most decision-relevant column you can build and the one comparison sites consistently omit. Judge the disclosure speed and the remediation as much as the incident itself.

zh-tw.commentary:
Bitwarden 拿下第一，理由很單純，這份榜單裡只有它的免費版是一個完整的產品。無限裝置同步、無限筆數、Passkey 也能存，通通不用錢。付費 Premium 在 2026 年 1 月從 9.99 美元漲到 19.80 美元，換算一年約六百多塊台幣，一個月不到六十元，比一杯超商大杯拿鐵還便宜。老實說就算翻倍了，這仍然是我敢推薦的年度稽核保險庫裡最便宜的一檔。4 月 22 日那次 npm 事件，惡意的 @bitwarden/cli@2026.4.0 套件在架上大約九十分鐘，範圍僅限開發者工具鏈，使用者的保險庫資料沒有受影響，官方幾天內就把完整時間軸公開。這種揭露速度本身就是我評分的重點。

1Password 排第二，靠的是 Secret Key 架構。這是一組在你裝置上產生、絕不上傳伺服器的 128 位元金鑰，跟主密碼合併後才拿去做金鑰推導，所以就算有人把整份加密保險庫從伺服器搬走，手上那份東西也開不了。講白了，這十年來整個品類事故不斷，1Password 的使用者保險庫始終沒被解開過。3 月 27 日調價後個人版一年 47.88 美元、家庭版 71.88 美元，這個價格是它沒能坐上第一的原因。

Proton Pass 是 2026 年最超值的一檔。Plus 方案現在一年 23.88 美元，約台幣七百多，而且直接把無限組 SimpleLogin email 別名包進去，等於保險庫加別名服務的價錢比別家單買保險庫還低。

今年還有一條主軸改變了我的評分方式。2 月 16 日 ETH Zurich 與 Università della Svizzera italiana 發表的論文，假設伺服器本身有惡意，對雲端保險庫做出 27 個可運作的攻擊情境，把「哪一家真的安全」從行銷話術變成同儕審查過的證據。再加上全球 Passkey 流通量已達 50 億組，iOS 26 也終於在作業系統層開放匯出 API，2026 年真正該問的是哪一家願意讓你帶著憑證離開。Bitwarden、Proton Pass 與 Apple Passwords 三家在這題上都給了乾脆的答案。

highlights.title: 一年六百多台幣的 Bitwarden，還是資安軟體裡最划算的一筆
highlights.body: 2026 年 1 月從 9.99 美元漲到 19.80 美元這件事讓不少老用戶不爽，很大一部分原因是 Bitwarden 把漲價消息包在一篇功能更新的部落格裡帶過，沒有正面公告。不過把這個數字換算成能買到什麼就很清楚了。同價位帶的其他家不是限制裝置數、就是限制筆數，或者把 Passkey 儲存鎖在付費層。Bitwarden 免費版完全沒有這些限制，Premium 再多給 TOTP 產生器、緊急聯絡人存取、1GB 加密附件和保險庫健康報告。同一時間 1Password 個人版一年 47.88 美元，是 Bitwarden Premium 的 2.4 倍，功能集卻在同一個層級。

highlights.title: Secret Key 是所有保險庫做過最聰明的一個架構決定
highlights.body: 所有雲端密碼管理器都是從主密碼推導出加密金鑰，1Password 多做了一件事，註冊時在你的裝置上生成一組 128 位元的 Secret Key，這組值從頭到尾不會傳到伺服器。兩者合併之後才進行金鑰推導，所以就算攻擊者把整個加密保險庫資料庫搬走，還是缺一塊從未離開你硬體的東西。實際證據就是紀錄本身，這十年整個品類事故一件接一件，1Password 的使用者保險庫始終沒被解開。我在評外洩紀錄這一欄的時候，能讓被偷走的資料庫變成廢鐵的架構，比任何一張認證徽章都更有份量。

highlights.title: ETH Zurich 那篇論文，重新定義了「通過稽核」值多少錢
highlights.body: 2 月 16 日 ETH Zurich 與 Università della Svizzera italiana 的研究人員發表了 27 個針對 Bitwarden、LastPass、Dashlane 與 1Password 的可運作攻擊情境，全部建立在伺服器本身有惡意或已被入侵的前提上。嚴重程度從資料完整性被破壞一路到整個組織的所有保險庫全部淪陷，這篇論文本月就要在巴爾的摩的 USENIX Security 上台。我從這件事學到的是，SOC 2 報告告訴你的是這家公司照著流程走，而這種對抗式的密碼學審查告訴你的是伺服器翻臉的時候會發生什麼。後面那個問題才是真正該問的，這也是我把開源、可獨立審閱的用戶端權重拉高的原因。

highlights.title: Passkey 是在擴充你的密碼管理器，不會取代它
highlights.body: FIDO Alliance 在 2026 年 World Passkey Day 統計全球流通量已達 50 億組，受訪者中有 75% 至少啟用過一組。這件事對你的保險庫真正的意義是，多數消費級 Passkey 就存在密碼管理器裡面，Passkey 用得越多，保險庫的價值越高。iOS 26 與 macOS 26 推出了實作 FIDO Credential Exchange Protocol 的 ASCredentialExportManager API，Bitwarden、Proton Pass 與 Apple Passwords 三家都支援用它把 Passkey 搬出去。可攜性從今年起在我這裡是一級評分項目，因為一組你匯不出來的憑證，實際上是廠商在控制而不在你手上。

highlights.title: 外洩紀錄應該直接做成比較表的一欄，但幾乎沒人這樣做
highlights.body: 英國 ICO 在 2025 年 11 月 20 日就 2022 年 LastPass 備份外洩開出 1,228,283 英鎊罰款，該次事件影響 160 萬名英國用戶，理由是技術與組織措施不足。2026 年 6 月 LastPass 確認第二起事件，攻擊者透過供應商 Klue 被竊的 OAuth 權杖取得客戶姓名、email、電話與客服案件內容，同一波受害的還有 HackerOne、Snyk 在內約兩百家公司，核心保險庫在這次事件中未受影響。我把這些寫出來，是因為一家保險庫的資安紀錄是最能左右決策的一欄，偏偏各大比較網站一律略過。看的時候把揭露速度跟後續處置跟事件本身放在一起評，判斷才會準。

en.commentary:
Bitwarden stays at number one, and the reason is that its free tier is genuinely complete. A 9.8 real cost score reflects unlimited passwords across unlimited devices with no payment, and a 9.8 migration score means importing from anywhere is a two-minute job. Combined with open source code that security researchers audit publicly, this is the recommendation I give to everyone who asks.

1Password at number two has the strongest breach record at 9.6 and the best sharing model at 9.4. For families and small teams where credentials need to move between people safely, the vault architecture is cleaner than anything else here. Travel Mode is also a genuinely thoughtful feature for anyone crossing borders with devices.

Proton Pass at number three earns a 9.5 real cost score and a 9.5 migration score, and it pairs naturally with ProtonVPN and Proton Mail if you are already in that ecosystem.

Apple Passwords posts a perfect 10.0 on real cost because it is included, and its 5.4 platform score reflects a design that assumes you stay inside Apple devices.

No changes this week.

highlights.title: Bitwarden's free tier is why it stays at number one
highlights.body: A 9.8 real cost score means unlimited passwords, unlimited devices and passkey support without paying anything. The code is open source and audited publicly. For a security product, being able to verify the implementation rather than trust a marketing page is the strongest argument available.

highlights.title: 1Password has the cleanest sharing model for families and teams
highlights.body: A 9.4 sharing score reflects an architecture built around separate vaults with granular permissions. A family shares streaming logins in one vault while keeping personal banking in another, and nobody has to think about it. The 9.6 breach record score reflects a company that has never lost customer vault data.

highlights.title: Migration difficulty is the real reason people stay on a bad manager
highlights.body: Bitwarden's 9.8 migration score and Proton Pass's 9.5 both matter more than they look. Importers that handle CSV exports from every major competitor, including browser-stored passwords, remove the main obstacle to switching. If a manager makes leaving hard, that is a reason to be cautious about joining.

zh-tw.commentary:
Bitwarden 維持第一，理由是它的免費版是真的完整。

9.8 分的實際成本反映的是不限密碼數量、不限裝置數量而且完全不用付錢，9.8 分的轉移分數代表從任何地方匯入都是兩分鐘的事。再加上開源程式碼，資安研究者可以公開稽核，這是我對每個來問的人給的答案。

第二名 1Password 的資安事故紀錄 9.6 分最好，分享模型 9.4 分也是最強的。家庭跟小團隊需要在人之間安全傳遞帳密，它的保險庫架構比這裡任何一家都乾淨。Travel Mode 對於要帶著裝置過海關的人，也是很用心的設計。

第三名 Proton Pass 實際成本 9.5 分、轉移 9.5 分，如果你本來就在用 ProtonVPN 跟 Proton Mail，搭起來很自然。

Apple Passwords 的實際成本是滿分 10.0，因為它本來就內建，而 5.4 分的平台分數反映的是一個假設你會一直待在 Apple 裝置裡的設計。

這週不動。

highlights.title: Bitwarden 第一名的關鍵就是它的免費版
highlights.body: 9.8 分的實際成本代表不限密碼、不限裝置、支援 passkey，而且一毛錢都不用付。程式碼開源而且公開稽核。對一個資安產品來說，能夠驗證實作而不是相信行銷頁面，這是最強的論點。

highlights.title: 家庭跟團隊分享最乾淨的是 1Password
highlights.body: 9.4 分的分享分數反映的是以獨立保險庫加細緻權限為核心的架構。一家人可以在一個庫裡共用串流帳號，個人的網銀放在另一個庫，完全不用擔心搞混。9.6 分的事故紀錄背後是一家從沒外洩過客戶保險庫資料的公司。

highlights.title: 很多人卡在爛的密碼管理器，真正的原因是搬家太難
highlights.body: Bitwarden 的 9.8 分跟 Proton Pass 的 9.5 分轉移分數，重要性比看起來高。匯入工具能吃下所有主要對手的 CSV 匯出檔，連瀏覽器存的密碼都能收，直接消除換平台最大的障礙。反過來說，一家讓你很難離開的服務，加入前就該多想一下。

en.commentary: Bitwarden holds first because it is open source, independently audited, and its free tier covers unlimited passwords across unlimited devices. Security you can verify beats security you have to trust, and the fact that a genuinely capable version costs nothing removes the last excuse anyone has for reusing passwords. 1Password at 9.2 has the better interface and its family sharing implementation is the most polished here, which matters when you are getting a household onto a manager. Proton Pass at 9.0 fits people already using Proton Mail and its email alias generation is genuinely useful for reducing spam and limiting breach exposure. NordPass at 8.4 offers solid functionality. Apple Passwords at 7.7 sits low despite being free and convenient, because cross-platform support is limited and lock-in is real. My practical guidance: the most important decision is starting to use one at all, and the second most important is enabling two-factor authentication on the vault itself. Export your data periodically too, because a manager you cannot leave is a manager that has you rather than the other way around. Every product here supports export, so use it.

highlights.title: Verifiable security beats trusted security
highlights.body: Bitwarden is open source and independently audited, so its claims can be checked rather than accepted. A free tier covering unlimited passwords on unlimited devices removes the last excuse for reusing credentials.

highlights.title: 1Password wins on getting a household onboard
highlights.body: The interface and family sharing implementation are the most polished here. When the challenge is convincing everyone in a home to actually use a manager, that ease matters more than technical depth.

highlights.title: Proton's aliases limit breach exposure
highlights.body: Generating a unique email address per service means a breach exposes one alias rather than your real address. That containment is a genuine security benefit beyond password storage.

highlights.title: Export your vault periodically
highlights.body: A manager you cannot leave has you rather than the other way around. Every product here supports export, so take a backup regularly and confirm you can read it outside the application.

zh-tw.commentary:
Bitwarden 守第一，因為它開源、有獨立稽核，而且免費方案就涵蓋無限組密碼跟無限裝置。可以驗證的安全性勝過只能相信的安全性，而一個真正堪用的版本完全免費這件事，等於拿掉了任何人重複使用密碼的最後藉口。

1Password 拿 9.2，介面更好，家庭共享的實作是這裡最完整的。要把全家人拉上密碼管理器的時候，這件事很重要。

Proton Pass 9.0 適合本來就在用 Proton Mail 的人，它的信箱別名產生器對減少垃圾信跟控制外洩影響範圍是真的有用。NordPass 8.4 功能扎實。

Apple Passwords 7.7 排得低，即使它免費又方便，因為跨平台支援有限，綁定效應是真的。

實用建議：最重要的決定是「開始用」，第二重要的是「幫金庫本身開啟兩步驟驗證」。另外請定期匯出資料，一個你離不開的管理器，是它管著你而不是你管著它。這裡每個產品都支援匯出，用它。

highlights.title: 可驗證的安全，勝過只能相信的安全
highlights.body: Bitwarden 開源且有獨立稽核，它的宣稱是可以查核而不是只能接受的。免費方案涵蓋無限組密碼跟無限裝置，也拿掉了重複使用密碼的最後藉口。

highlights.title: 要拉全家上車就選 1Password
highlights.body: 介面跟家庭共享的實作是這裡最完整的。當挑戰是說服全家人真的開始使用時，這份易用性比技術深度重要。

highlights.title: Proton 的別名限縮外洩影響
highlights.body: 每個服務用一個獨立信箱別名，一旦外洩暴露的是別名而不是你的真實地址。這份隔離是超越密碼儲存本身的實質安全效益。

highlights.title: 定期把金庫匯出來
highlights.body: 一個你離不開的管理器，是它在管你。這裡每個產品都支援匯出，請定期備份，並確認你在應用程式之外也讀得懂那份檔案。
